title: lamium amplexicaule var. orientale
intro: Lamium amplexicaule var. orientale, commonly known as Oriental Spotted Deadnettle, is a plant species belonging to the mint family, Lamiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to promote overall well-being and alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Lamium amplexicaule var. orientale include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-bacterial properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-convulsant properties.
